title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Repair-Class Weight for an Alignment Comeback Credit
content:
The repair-class weight applied to an alignment comeback credit on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order is **1.0** where the claim repair's class is a structural class (its name contains Structural), **0.80** where it is a Major Claim Repair, and **0.60** otherwise.

## Records the weight is read from

The weight is read from the class of the vehicle's network insurance claim repair, as recorded on the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs record. A class is structural where its name contains the word Structural.

| Class of the claim repair | Repair-class weight |
|---|---|
| A class whose name contains Structural | 1.0 |
| Major Claim Repair | 0.80 |
| Any other class, for instance an Express Claim Repair or a Standard Claim Repair | 0.60 |

## Illustration (hypothetical amount figured on of 100.00 USD)

At a weight of 1.0 the amount is carried in full, 100.00 USD; at 0.80 it becomes 80.00 USD; at 0.60 it becomes 60.00 USD.
